== English Virtual Original comparison ==
July and October name any opponent’s combat vehicle as a battle-destiny condition. The remastered publisher slip and Holotable full card print AT-AT. The July 2007 Appendix B ruling explains the alternative piloting cases but still describes combat vehicle. The ruling does not supply a complete replacement. The table reproduces the two printed conditions.
